Our approach

Illustrative. Refurbishment of a Victorian living room.

Property intelligence

A disciplined approach to London residential investment.

We combine local insight, data led underwriting and design expertise to unlock the potential in existing homes across London's boroughs. Every opportunity is appraised line by line before we commit.

Illustrative appraisal of the kind of opportunity we look for: an unmodernised one bedroom flat in Hackney, bought below market value, fully refurbished and extended. Total project cost includes stamp duty, fees, works, contingency and selling costs. Not a completed project. Figures before tax.

£518kTotal project cost

21.5%Margin on sale value
27.4%Return on cost

Potential starts before the plans do.

Most of the value in a London home is settled before any work begins, in what the building could be allowed to become.

Planning uplift

We look for homes where planning can add space: lofts, side returns, rear extensions and better layouts. Each proposal is tested against local policy and what has already been approved on the same street, so the added space is grounded in precedent.

Refurbishment

We then deliver the works: sensible layouts, durable materials and period details kept where they matter. The result is a home that works better for the people who live in it and holds its value for longer.

+16 m²Added through planning

We started by asking why so much of London goes unused.

Our story

Reforia was founded by two friends who met as students in London, one at UCL and one at LSE. What we had in common was a habit of building things, and a feeling that the way homes are bought and improved in this city had barely changed in decades.

A year ago we moved into property. We worked in the field first, learning how opportunities are found, appraised and delivered. Then we started our own company.

Founders

Chemistry, UCL

A background in real estate in Dubai, one of the fastest moving property markets in the world.

Management, LSE

A background in finance, bringing the discipline of pricing risk and underwriting every decision.

How we work

From the start, we built Reforia around AI and data. Our agents handle the work that can be automated, so our time is spent on strategy, analysis and the decisions that shape the outcome of every project.

The result is a small team that can look at more of London, more carefully, than a traditional developer of our size.
